title: To Weather the Storm: faction and parallel prerequisites
status: repaired/deployed; native automated checks passed; client pending
observed_failures: Alliance38405 had PrevQuestID0 and no other prerequisite relation/condition; native race+previous admission allowed it before38312. Horde38614 already required rewarded38612.

Both members of each parallel pair had NextQuestID pointing to38410/38615 with ExclusiveGroup0. QuestData appends both predecessors, but native SatisfyQuestPreviousQuest treats them as OR alternatives. Either rewarded member alone therefore admitted Impalement Insurance. A completed but unreported sibling could be skipped.
evidence_and_inference: Installed native QuestLineXQuest132/133 lists A Grapple a Day, No Wings Required, To Weather the Storm and Impalement Insurance in corresponding order. Both pairs already share the same next destination, rewards and race-restricted quest givers. Native quest text describes infiltration and collecting the climbing equipment; QuestLine order alone does not encode prerequisite semantics.

Inference for the restored gate: No Wings Required and To Weather the Storm are the parallel tasks after A Grapple a Day, and their common successor requires both. The existing Horde predecessor and both faction layouts support this interpretation. Public documented progression independently corroborates the parallel stage; its current scaled-level text is not substituted for native7.3.5 quest data.
repair: Migration2026_10_17_03 sets only missing38405.PrevQuestID=38312; groups38318/38405 as-38318 and38613/38614 as-38613 when their groups are0 and existing NextQuestID agrees. Native negative-group semantics require every same-race member to be rewarded. Preserve individual Prev/Next/RewardNext links and custom nonzero groups/prerequisites.
checks: Test-StormheimWeatherChainData.ps1 repeats the real migration in temporary copies and compares complete addon rows, including unrelated38558. Custom predecessor99999/group123 and group456 survive; live NPC questgiver flags and existing relations agree.

Test-StormheimWeatherChain.ps1 -VerifyReleaseBinary compiles the real Prev/Next and exclusive-group loading, SatisfyQuestPreviousQuest/SatisfyQuestRace, GetNextQuest and NPC reward-next fragment. Reproduces original early Alliance availability and all four either-member bypasses, then checks both factions and both reward orders.

Before A Grapple a Day is rewarded, weather acceptance fails even if the prerequisite is completed. After reward both parallel tasks are admitted. Wrong-race admission fails; all64 race-mask bits use native checks.

After only one parallel reward, the next quest and details window stay unavailable while its independent NPC reward callback still runs. Completed-but-unrewarded sibling is insufficient. Rewarding the second member opens the existing next details through the actual starter relation; rebuilt history preserves the gate.

Existing Helheim supplies/item/reward-next regression passes. Canonical Release contains the reward-next admission diagnostic, uses its original actual game Release final-link input, and passed the ready/shutdown smoke with both data migrations loaded.
limits: The CanTakeQuest fixture combines native race and previous-quest checks; full native quest level/class/daily/condition/session/menu admission is outside this harness. World lookup, history reconstruction and packets are fixtures. No database character rows are changed.

Client pending: both faction menus and phase transitions, accepting the parallel quests together, completing/turning them in in either order, correct successor details/reward callbacks after relog. Existing item/quest/visual and earlier audit client requirements remain.
Native QuestLine order and modern public documentation corroborate content sequencing, not live7.3.5 client verification.
